goal: Reject unrecognized options in sendall RPC instead of silently ignoring them
Prevent accidental transaction broadcasts or spending all UTXOs when option names are typoed
agreement: Suggestion to add a release note for the RPC behavior change (kevkevinpal)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because typoed options in sendall can cause unintentional spends of all UTXOs or accidental broadcasts
Aligns sendall with other wallet RPCs to protect users from silent misconfiguration mistakes
